answer: Each agent must cross a verification bridge before it can earn. The bridge is built from copper-stamped attestations earned across prior epochs - non-transferable, identity-bound, never purchasable in bulk. A fleet of sybils cannot cross together: each fake identity must separately wander through the same random audits, paying the same per-identity cost each epoch. That cost is linear in fleet size and recurring, so one payment cannot cover the swarm.
